base_url.correction: No operational PatentsView API base URL is currently published; API functions have been paused since March 20, 2026 during migration to the USPTO Open Data Portal.

rate_limits.correction: The last officially published PatentSearch API limit was 45 requests per minute per API key; the API is currently paused.

example.correction: No current working curl example is available because the search.patentsview.org PatentSearch API is paused during the ODP transition.

description.correction: PatentsView currently provides enhanced USPTO patent datasets and bulk downloads through ODP; its search and API functions are temporarily paused pending reintroduction in updated forms.

notes: The entry is not operational in August 2026. USPTO announced that PatentsView APIs would pause on March 20, and its June 2026 hub lists current bulk-data products but no restored API. The old documentation returns 502, and the old key-request page redirects to the ODP transition guide.
